name: rag-in-the-box
description: Multi-tenant retrieval-augmented generation platform that runs on the Cloudflare free tier.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api:only" "npm:dev:web:only"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm run test
